description: This file defines the Goteo\Controller\Admin\ReviewsSubController class, which manages review-related administrative actions such as listing, editing, reporting, closing, assigning, and unassigning reviews within the Goteo project. It handles access permissions, user actions, and interacts with models like Review, Project, and User to perform CRUD operations and trigger feed events.

classes.name: ReviewsSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative review processes including list, add, edit, report, close, assign, unassign, and permission checks within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform actions based on node role and admin privileges.

methods.name: reportAction
methods.description: Handles displaying detailed report of a review, includes project and evaluation data.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing review, saves changes, and triggers events.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles creation of a new review, saves data, and triggers events.

methods.name: closeAction
methods.description: Marks a review as closed and logs the event.

methods.name: assignAction
methods.description: Assigns a review to a user and logs the assignment.

methods.name: unassignAction
methods.description: Removes a review assignment from a user.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of reviews with filtering options.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method handling various review processes such as add, edit, close, report, assign, and unassign, with internal logic for each case.
